OpenAI.Note: OpenAI applies mandatory moderation on all API calls automatically. The API endpoint does not support threshold configuration.

Anthropic.Note: Anthropic applies mandatory safety filters on all API calls automatically. The API endpoint does not support threshold configuration.

GitHub.//AllowedOwners: Repository owners the GitHub tools may query. An absent or empty list falls back to these same four.

AiUsageGuard.//MaxMessageCharacters: Longest message accepted for an operator-funded chat turn (a system model, or no model named and no user model). Turns on the user's own model are not capped. 0 turns the cap off.
AiUsageGuard.//MaxInitialPromptCharacters: session/create's InitialPrompt is truncated to this length, never refused. 0 turns truncation off.
AiUsageGuard.//MaxUserDailyCostUsd: Operator-funded estimated spend per user per UTC day (roles 1-3) before chat is refused. Applies to system configurations reached through group or system-wide access, and to sub-agent runs on server keys. 0 turns it off.
AiUsageGuard.//MaxUserDailyRuns: Operator-funded chat turns plus sub-agent runs per user per UTC day; bounds unpriced runs. 0 turns it off.
AiUsageGuard.//MaxConcurrentTurnsPerUser: Operator-funded answers being generated at once per user, across sessions. 0 turns it off.
AiUsageGuard.//AlertUserDailyCostUsd: Admin alert banner when a non-admin user's operator-funded spend in the last 24 hours reaches this. Never limits anyone. 0 turns it off.
AiUsageGuard.//ExemptAdmins: Administrators are never limited by the guard.

PrivacySettings.//KeyRing: Content key material lives in User Secrets, never here. Set PrivacySettings:KeyRing:v1 to a base64 32-byte key and PrivacySettings:ActiveKeyVersion to v1. ConfigHealthService raises a startup alert while it is missing.

Attachments.//MalwareScanner: One or more of Amsi, ClamAv, None, comma-separated. Two or more run through CompositeAntiMalwareScanner: any detection refuses the upload, and a failure is reported only when none of them managed to scan. An unknown name is ignored with a warning and never treated as None.
Attachments.//AllowedExtensions: This list and chat.component.html's accept attribute are the same list. AttachmentValidator reads it from here precisely so the picker and the server cannot drift apart; changing one without the other gives a user a file dialog offering what the server then refuses.
Attachments.//BinaryDocumentContentTypes: Types whose bytes are legitimately binary. Each is checked against its own signature instead of the control-byte scan that catches a payload declared as text; without this list every PDF and every OpenXML document would be refused as text containing binary data.

RateLimits.//LoginPermitsPerMinute: Sign-in attempts per remote IP address per minute, on the password, 2FA and GnollHack session-create routes. Needs real client addresses behind a proxy.

PrivacySettings.//DlpFloor: Classes the operator forces on for every user, whatever the user's own switch says. A floor can only add masking, never remove it; false means the user decides. The built-in defaults are on for API keys, private keys, tokens, passwords, cards, IBANs and SSNs, and off for e-mail addresses and phone numbers.

//DocumentSettings: Bounds on text extraction from an uploaded document. The cap is on extracted CHARACTERS rather than input bytes, because a small compressed file can expand a very long way.
//RagSettings: Retrieval for a document too large to send whole. DirectIngestionMaxTokens is the threshold, and it is deliberately generous: below it the document is passed IN FULL, which is the better answer against a large context window -- chunking a short report costs latency and answer coherence for no privacy gain, since the excerpts that do get sent are the relevant ones either way. EmbeddingModelPath and EmbeddingVocabPath are empty by default: the ONNX model is a ~90 MB binary that is not in this repository, and retrieval degrades to BM25 whenever it is absent, which is a logged warning and never a failure.

RagSettings.//WriteSidecars: Whether a document's chunks and embeddings are stored beside the attachment. OFF by default, and deliberately: chunk text is verbatim document content and an embedding is invertible enough to be treated the same way, and nothing reads a sidecar yet -- an uploaded document reaches the model on the turn it is attached and is not replayed afterwards. Turning it on is what a change adding cross-turn retrieval would do; the encryption, the ephemeral skip and the purge behaviour are already in place and tested.

ChatRetentionSettings.//AuditLogRetentionDays: Days a ChatAccessAuditLog row is kept. This is the only setting anywhere that removes an audit row, so the window is long by default: an incident is usually noticed months after it happened. Zero or negative disables pruning entirely, which is the right choice for a deployment that needs the journal to be genuinely append-only -- although real immutability needs storage the application cannot rewrite, which no setting here can provide.
ChatRetentionSettings.//PruneDismissedAiErrorLogDays: Days a dismissed SystemAiErrorLog row is kept after dismissal. Undismissed rows are never pruned. Zero disables pruning.
ChatRetentionSettings.//PruneSecurityEventDays: Days a SecurityEvent run is kept after it was last seen. Events of a user with an active account hold or a pending deletion request are kept until that is decided. Zero disables pruning.
ChatRetentionSettings.//PruneChatProviderAttemptDays: Days a ChatProviderAttempt row (one provider attempt of a chat or title-generation call) is kept. Zero disables pruning.
ChatRetentionSettings.//MaintenanceHistoryRetentionDays: Days a MaintenanceRunLog row (one per maintenance pass or admin maintenance action) is kept. Zero disables pruning.

IdentityLockout.//: Shared by the website (MobileGnollHackLogger) and Overseer, which sign in against the same accounts: keep both files identical.

GameApiSecurity.//: Sign-in throttling for /api/session/create, which GnollHack calls with its stored credentials. The pair limit is per account and address; the account limit is across addresses. Per-IP limits need real client addresses: see docs/overseer/security-monitoring.md.

AdminUserManagement.//: The admin Users tab: per-user actions and the Bulk Actions wizard. Bulk delete never touches an account registered within BulkDeleteMinAccountAgeDays or signed in within BulkDeleteRecentSignInDays.

AccountHold.//: Holds an account deletion for administrator review. Shared by the website and Overseer: keep both files identical.
AccountHold.//SeriousProviderCodes: ProviderSafetyBlock / ProviderPolicyRejection event codes that name prohibited content. Refusals, usage volume and limit refusals never count.
AccountHold.//ReviewNotificationEmail: Address emailed when a deletion is held for review; empty = admin alert only.
AccountHold.//ReviewEmailMinIntervalHours: At most one review email per user account within this many hours.
AccountHold.//OverseerAdminUrl: Website only: the Overseer admin page the review email links to; empty = no link.

LegalDocuments.//: Terms of Service read from the wiki clone at WikiPath. VersionSource DocumentDate reads the page's '**Last updated:** 18 October 2026' line, with the Git commit date as the fallback; GitCommitDate makes every commit a new version.

PrivacyNotice.//: Statements shown in § 7 of the /privacy notice. An item without a statement renders as Not supplied by the operator.

legalEntity.Text: Gnoll Overseer is operated by Hyvän mielen pelit ry (Sound Mind Games), a non-profit association registered in Finland. The Terms of Service set Finnish law for users outside the United States, and United States federal law and Delaware law for users in the United States.
legalEntity.Source: Gnoll Overseer Terms of Service, opening paragraph and § 13

contact.Text: Write to gnollhack@hyvanmielenpelit.fi. You can also delete your account and all its Overseer data yourself from the Personal Data page of your GnollHack account.
contact.Source: Gnoll Overseer Privacy Policy, Contact and Account Deletion

dataProcessingAgreement.Text: No data processing agreement is offered. Gnoll Overseer is a consumer service, and Hyvän mielen pelit ry is the controller of the data it processes.

breachNotification.Text: A suspected personal-data breach is assessed by Hyvän mielen pelit ry. Where GDPR requires it, it is notified to the Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, and to affected users without undue delay when it is likely to result in a high risk to them.

dataResidency.Text: Overseer's server is located in the United States. Inference runs wherever the AI provider chosen for a message runs it; no region is guaranteed for any provider.
dataResidency.Source: Gnoll Overseer Privacy Policy, Data Collected

telemetryRetention.Text: Error telemetry sent to Sentry is kept for 90 days, the retention of the operator's Sentry plan, and then deleted by Sentry.

acceptableUse.Text: The Gnoll Overseer Terms of Service set the rules for using this deployment and what happens when they are broken.

Compliance.PurposeStatement: Internal evaluation of candidate AI models for the Overseer assistant within GnollHack. Benchmark outputs are third-party generated content used solely for automated capability evaluation and scoring, and are not used for training, fine-tuning, distilling, or developing competing AI models.
